title: Run /doctor in Claude Code (2-minute tune-up) #aiforbusiness #aiagents #aitools #claudecode
description:
Do yourself a favor and run /doctor in Claude Code.

It's a built-in, read-only checkup for your setup. It flags unused plugins, stale files, and version drift, then cleans it up only
after you approve. Nothing changes until you say so.

My run: setup healthy, 2 unused plugins trimmed, and about 160 tokens of context handed back every single session.

Two minutes, zero risk. Follow for more AI systems I actually use.
